title: degenerate_stack_no_mcaEvent as the countermodel to list-LB->incidence-LB; non-degenerate fix only at the excluded t=1 sliver
evidence: Probes scripts/probes/_407_conn/C015_{nondegen_stack_loss,loss_ratio_prize,t2_deep_interior,averaging_family_deep}.py, exact integer arithmetic over F_12289, domain = mu_n proper dyadic subgroup (n=8,16; (q-1)%n==0; beta=log q/log n ~ 3.4-4.5, prize regime). Via the in-tree bridge badScalars_monomial_eq_degreeLTSucc (MonomialLineListBridge.lean): bad gamma of line (u0,X^k) for RS[k] = leading X^k-coeff of a deg<(k+1) poly agreeing with u0 on >=(1-delta)n pts, with non-matchable 2nd row. FINDINGS: (1) The non-degenerate monomial stack (u0,X^k) FIXES the degenerate defect: at delta=1-(k+1)/n every a=k+1 subset is non-matchable (X^k extends to no deg<k codeword on k+1 pts), so mca-firing-subsets = #subsets (e.g. n=16,k=8: 11440/11440) -- UNLIKE (w,0) which fires 0. (2) Two losses appear: list-count->distinct-bad-gamma is real (11440 polys -> 3280 distinct leading coeffs) but mild; the FATAL loss is radius: averaging list (deg<k+t agreement) and bridge-bad-gamma object (deg<k+1 lifts) COINCIDE only at t=1 (a=k+1, the near-1-rho sliver). At t>=2 (moving into the deep interior toward 1-sqrt rho) the averaging family pS=X^a-nodal_S has degree up to k+t-1 >= k+1, NOT deg<k+1, so bridge-relevant count collapses: n=16,k=8,t=2 gives 8008 averaging members -> 56 deg<k+1 -> 0 bad gamma for a single-base received word. (3) The averaging reverse bound C(n,k+t)/q^t is itself VACUOUS at prize scale (q >> C(n,k+t) => floor=0). delta=1-(k+1)/n sits in the Theta(1/log n) sliver EXCLUDED from the prize window (1-sqrt rho, 1-rho-Theta(1/log n)) since (k+1)/n - rho = 1/n << 1/log n.
reduced_to: To realize many DISTINCT bad gamma at t>=2 (the actual prize interior, NOT the t=1 near-1-rho sliver), one needs a received word u0 admitting >> n independent degree-<(k+1) Reed-Solomon explanations on size-(k+t) sets with non-matchable second row. That count IS the deep-interior list-decoding cluster size of RS[k+1] beyond Johnson over mu_n -- i.e. the BGK sqrt-cancellation list size for thin multiplicative subgroups. C015's 'replace (w,0) by a non-degenerate (u0,X^k) realizing the same averaging list' is achievable at t=1 (excluded sliver) but at t>=2 it reduces exactly to producing such a high-multiplicity received word, which is the open core.
wall: BGK/Paley sqrt-cancellation deep-interior list-decoding count for thin mu_n (the t>=2 distinct-bad-gamma list = deep RS[k+1] list size beyond Johnson)
honest_note: The connection's STRUCTURAL diagnosis is correct and sharp and is confirmed by probe: the in-tree reverse bound (averaging_list_lower_bound) is real but the degenerate stack (w,0) fires no mcaEvent, and a non-degenerate monomial stack does fire mcaEvents -- so the constructive demand is partially met. But the proposed fix does NOT close anything: it only works at t=1 = the near-capacity sliver EXCLUDED from the prize window, and the averaging-list/bad-gamma objects DECOUPLE (collapse to 0) at t>=2 in the deep interior. No closure; this is an honest reduction welding C015 back to the BGK/Paley wall. NOT refuted: the diagnosis stands; only the implied easy fix fails. Recommend logging the t>=2 averaging/bridge decoupling to DISPROOF_LOG as the obstruction to the 'non-degenerate stack' route.
